info.name: Protect The Nautilus' Emergency Food Supply

descriptions.notStarted: Apparently, pigs and ribbon pigs have been coming onto The Nautilus every night to eat up the ship's emergency food supply. At this rate, the people on The Nautilus may end up starving! I should go see Tangyoon, the ship's Head Chef and talk to him about this.
descriptions.inProgress:
Tangyoon says pigs and ribbon pigs keep coming onto The Nautilus' emergency food supply and eating up all the food, and there's only a little bit left in storage! I'm gonna have to teach these #rpigs#k and #rribbon pigs#k a lesson they'll remember.
